title.narrative: Strengthened institutional capacity of workers' organizations

description.narrative: In Moldova, the National Confederation of Trade Unions of Moldova (CNSM) and its affiliates are actively working to strengthen their relevance for workers and to expand their membership base in a changing labour market context. This includes a focus on reaching under-represented groups, such as young workers, workers in non-standard forms of employment, and those in the informal economy. CNSM and its affiliates are increasingly exploring and piloting more innovative approaches to organizing, communication, and service delivery, with the aim of better responding to the needs and expectations of current and potential members. ILO will provide support to improve internal capacities in fields such as internal governance, strategies to increase trade union relevance for workers and developing new or enhanced services that make trade unions more accessible and responsive. These may include strengthened advisory services, awareness-raising campaigns, and targeted outreach initiatives. At the same time, CNSM and its affiliates are reinforcing their ability to analyse labour market developments and use evidence to inform their organizing strategies and service provision. Experiences from these initiatives are being documented and shared within the trade union movement, contributing to learning, adaptation, and the potential scaling up of successful approaches.
